aey logo ! apney perwerdigar say daro jiss ney tumhen aik jaan say peda kiya , aur ussi say uss ki biwi peda ki , aur unn dono say boht say mard aur aurten ( duniya mein ) phela diye . aur Allah say daro jiss ka wasta dey ker tum aik doosray say apney huqooq maangtay ho ,   aur rishta daariyon ( ki haq talfi say ) daro . yaqeen rakho kay Allah tumhari nigrani ker-raha hai .
aur yateemon ko unn kay maal dey do , aur achay maal ko kharab maal say tabdeel naa kero , aur unn ( yateemon ) ka maal apney maal kay sath mila ker matt khao .   beyshak yeh bara gunah hai

aur agar tumhen yeh andesha ho kay tum yateemon kay baaray mein insaf say kaam nahi ley sako gay to ( unn say nikah kernay kay bajaye ) doosri aurton mein say kissi say nikah kerlo jo tumhen pasand ayen .   do do say , teen teen say , aur chaar chaar say .   haan ! agar tumhen yeh khatra ho kay tum ( unn biwiyon ) kay darmiyan insaf naa ker-sako gay to phir aik hi biwi per iktifa kero , ya unn kaneezon per jo tumhari milkiyat mein hain . iss tareeqay mein iss baat ka ziyada imkan hai kay tum bey insafi mein mubtala nahi hogay .
aur aurton ko unn kay mehar khushi say diya kero . haan ! agar woh khud uss ka kuch hissa khush dili say chorr den to ussay khushgawari aur mazay say khalo .

aur nasamajh ( yateemon ) ko apney woh maal hawalay naa kero jinn ko Allah ney tumharay liye zindagi ka sarmaya banaya hai ; haan unn ko unn mein say khilao aur pehnao , aur unn say munasib andaz mein baat kerlo .

aur yateemon ko janchtay raho , yahan tak kay jab woh nikah kay laeeq umar ko phonch jayen , to agar tum yeh mehsoos kero kay unn mein samajh daari aa-chuki hai to unn kay maal unhi kay hawalay kerdo . aur yeh maal fuzool kharchi ker kay aur yeh soch ker jaldi jaldi naa kha betho kay woh kahen baray naa hojayen . aur ( yateemon kay sarpraston mein say ) jo khud maal daar ho woh to apney aap ko ( yateem ka maal khaney say ) bilkul pak rakhay , haan agar woh khud mohtaj ho to maroof tareeq-e-kaar ko malhooz rakhtay huye kha ley .   phir jab tum unn kay maal unhen do to unn per gawah bana lo , aur Allah hisab lenay kay liye kafi hai .

mardon kay liye bhi uss maal mein hissa hai jo walaiden aur qareeb tareen rishta daaron ney chorra ho , aur aurton kay liye bhi uss maal mein hissa hai jo walaiden aur qareeb tareen rishta daaron ney chorra ho , chahye woh ( tarka ) thora ho ya ziyada , yeh hissa ( Allah ki taraf say ) muqarrar hai .
aur jab ( meeras ki ) taqseem kay waqt ( ghair waris ) rishta daar , yateem aur miskeen log aajayen , to unn ko bhi uss mein say kuch dey do , aur unn say munasib andaz mein baat kero .

aur woh log ( yateemon kay maal mein khurd-burd kernay say ) daren jo agar apney peechay kamzor bacchay chorr ker jayen to unn ki taraf say fiker mand rahen gay .   lehaza woh Allah say daren aur seedhi seedhi baat kaha keren .
yaqeen rakho kay jo log yateemon ka maal nahaq khatay hain , woh apney pet mein aag bhar rahey hain , aur unhen jald hi aik dehakti aag mein dakhil hona hoga .

Allah tumhari aulad kay baaray mein tum ko hukum deta hai kay :  mard ka hissa do aurton kay barabar hai .   aur agar ( sirf ) aurten hi hon , do ya do say ziyada , to marney walay ney jo kuch chorra ho , unhen uss ka do tehai hissa milay ga . aur agar sirf aik aurat ho to ussay ( tarkay ka ) aadha hissa milay ga . aur marney walay kay walaiden mein say her aik ko tarkay ka chata hissa milay ga , ba-shartey-kay marney walay ki koi aulad ho , aur agar uss ki koi aulad naa ho aur uss kay walaiden hi uss kay waris hon to uss ki maa tehai hissay ki haq daar hai . haan agar uss kay kaee bhai hon to uss ki maa ko chata hissa diya jaye ga ( aur yeh sari taqseem ) uss wasiyyat per amal kernay kay baad hogi jo marney walay ney ki ho , ya agar uss kay zimmay koi qarz hai to uss ki adaegi kay baad .   tumhen iss baat ka theek theek ilm nahi hai kay tumharay baap beton mein say kon faeeda phonchanay kay lehaz say tum say ziyada qareeb hai ? yeh to Allah kay muqarrar kiye huye hissay hain ;   yaqeen rakho kay Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

aur tumhari biwiyan jo kuch chorr ker jayen , uss ka aadha hissa tumhara hai , ba-shartey-kay unn ki koi aulad ( zinda ) naa ho . aur agar unn ki koi aulad ho to uss wasiyyat per amal kernay kay baad jo unhon ney ki ho , aur unn kay qarz ki adaegi kay baad tumhen unn kay tarkay ka chothai hissa milay ga . aur tum jo kuch chorr ker jao uss ka aik chothai unn ( biwiyon ) ka hai , ba-shartey-kay tumhari koi aulad ( zinda ) naa ho . aur agar tumhari koi aulad ho to uss wasiyyat per amal kernay kay baad jo tum ney ki ho , aur tumharay qarz ki adaegi kay baad unn ko tumharay tarkay ka aathwan hissa milay ga . aur agar woh mard ya aurat jiss ki meeras taqseem honi hai , aisa ho kay naa uss kay walaiden zinda hon naa aulad , aur uss ka aik bhai ya aik behan zinda ho to unn mein say her aik chatay hissay ka haq daar hai . aur agar woh iss say ziyada hon to woh sabb aik tehai mein shareek hon gay . ( magar ) jo wasiyyat ki gaee ho uss per amal kernay kay baad aur marney walay kay zimmay jo qarz ho uss ki adaegi kay baad , ba-shartey-kay ( wasiyyat ya qarz kay iqrar kernay say ) uss ney kissi ko nuqsan naa phonchaya ho .   yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hukum hai , aur Allah her baat ka ilm rakhney wala , burdbaar hai .

yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood hain , aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat keray ga , woh uss ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , aesay log hamesha unn ( baaghaat ) mein rahen gay , aur yeh zabardast kamiyabi hai .

aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani keray ga aur uss ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood say tajawuz keray ga , ussay Allah dozakh mein dakhil keray ga jiss mein woh hamesha rahey ga , aur uss ko aisa azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

tumhari aurton mein say jo bad-kaari ka irtikab keren , unn per apney mein say chaar gawah bana lo . chunacheh agar woh ( unn ki bad-kaari ki ) gawahi den to unn aurton ko gharon mein rok ker rakho yahan tak kay unhen moat utha kerlay jaye , ya Allah unn kay liye koi aur raasta peda kerday .

aur tum mein say jo do mard bad-kaari ka irtikab keren , unn ko aziyat do .   phir agar woh tauba ker kay apni islaah kerlen to unn say darguzar kero . beyshak Allah boht tauba qubool kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

Allah ney tauba qubool kernay ki jo zimma daari li hai woh unn logon  kay liye hai jo nadani say koi burai ker daaltay hain , phir jaldi hi tauba kerletay hain . chunacheh Allah unn ki tauba qubool kerleta hai , aur Allah her baat ko khoob janney wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi .

tauba ki qubooliyat unn kay liye nahi jo buray kaam kiye jatay hain , yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi per moat ka waqt aa-khara hota hai to woh kehta hai kay mein ney abb tauba kerli hai , aur naa unn kay liye hai jo kufr hi ki halat mein mar-jatay hain . aesay logon  kay liye to hum ney dukh denay wala azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

aey emaan walo ! yeh baat tumharay liye halal nahi hai kay tum zabardasti aurton kay malik ban betho , aur unn ko iss gharz say muqayyad matt kero kay tum ney jo kuch unn ko diya hai uss ka kuch hissa ley urro , illa yeh kay woh khuli bey hayai ka irtikab keren .   aur unn kay sath bhalay andaz mein zindagi basar kero , aur agar tum unhen pasand naa kertay ho to yeh aen mumkin hai kay tum kissi cheez ko napasand kertay ho aur Allah ney uss mein boht kuch bhalai rakh di ho .

aur agar tum aik biwi kay badlay doosri biwi say nikah kerna chahtay ho aur unn mein say aik ko dher sara mehar dey chukay ho , to uss mein say kuch wapis naa lo . kiya tum bohtan laga ker aur khula gunah ker kay ( mehar ) wapis lo gay ?
aur aakhir tum kaisay ( woh mehar ) wapis ley saktay ho jabkay tum aik doosray kay itney qareeb hochukay thay aur unhon ney tum say bara bhari ehad liya tha-?

aur jinn aurton say tumharay baap dada ( kissi waqt ) nikah ker-chukay hon , tum unhen nikah mein naa lao , albatta pehlay jo kuch hochuka woh hochuka .   yeh bari bey hayai hai , ghinaona amal hai , aur bey raah  ravi  ki baat hai .

tum per haram kerdi gaee hain tumhari mayen , tumhari betiyan , tumhari behney , tumhari phoopiyan , tumhari khalaayen , aur bhateejiyan aur bhanjiyan , aur tumhari woh mayen jinhon ney tumhen doodh pilaya hai , aur tumhari doodh shareek behney , aur tumhari biwiyon ki mayen , aur tumharay zair-e-perwerish tumhari soteli betiyan   jo tumhari unn biwiyon ( kay pet ) say hon jinn kay sath tum ney khilwat ki ho . haan agar tum ney unn kay sath khilwat naa ki ho ( aur unhen talaq dey di ho ya unn ka intiqal hogaya ho ) to tum per ( unn ki larkiyon say nikah kernay mein ) koi gunah nahi hai , neez tumharay sulbi beton ki biwiyan bhi tum per haram hain , aur yeh baat bhi haram hai kay tum do behnon ko aik sath nikah mein jama kero , albatta jo kuch pehlay hochuka woh hochuka . beyshak Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

neez woh aurten ( tum per haram hain ) jo doosray shohron kay nikah mein hon , albatta jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein aajayen ( woh mustasna hain ) .   Allah ney yeh ehkaam tum per farz kerdiye hain . inn aurton ko chorr ker tamam aurton kay baaray mein yeh halal kerdiya gaya hai kay tum apna maal ( bator mehar ) kharch ker kay unhen ( apney nikah mein lana ) chahao , ba-shartey-kay tum unn say ba-qaeeda nikah ka rishta qaeem ker kay iffat hasil kero , sirf shehwat nikalna maqsood naa ho .   chunacheh jinn aurton say ( nikah ker kay ) tum ney lutf uthaya ho , unn ko unn ka woh mehar ada kero jo muqarrar kiya gaya ho . albatta mehar muqarrar kernay kay baad bhi jiss ( kami beshi ) per tum aapas mein razi hojao , uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi . yaqeen rakho kay Allah her baat ka ilm bhi rakhta hai , hikmat ka bhi malik hai .

aur tum mein say jo log iss baat ki taqat naa rakhtay hon kay azad musalman aurton say nikah ker-saken , to woh unn musalman kaneezon mein say kissi say nikah ker saktay hain jo tumhari milkiyat mein hon , aur Allah ko tumharay emaan ki poori halat khoob maloom hai . tum sabb aapas mein aik jaisay ho .    
  lehaza inn kaneezon say inn kay malikon ki ijazat say nikah kerlo , aur inn ko qaeeday kay mutabiq inn kay mehar ada kero , ba-shartey-kay unn say nikah ka rishta qaeem ker kay unhen pak daman banaya jaye ; naa woh sirf shehwat poori kernay kay liye koi ( najaeez ) kaam keren , aur naa khufiya tor per najaeez aashnaiyan peda keren . phir jab woh nikah ki hifazat mein aajayen , aur uss kay baad kissi bari bey hayai ( yani zina ) ka irtikab keren to unn per uss saza say aadhi saza wajib hogi jo ( ghair shaadi shuda ) azad aurton kay liye muqarrar hai .   yeh sabb ( yani kaneezon say nikah kerna ) tum mein say unn logon  kay liye hai jinn ko ( nikah naa kernay ki soorat mein ) gunah mein mubtala honey ka andesha ho . aur agar tum sabar hi kiye raho to yeh tumharay liye boht behtar hai . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

Allah chahta hai kay tumharay liye ( ehkaam ki ) wazahat kerday , aur jo ( naik ) log tum say pehlay guzray hain , tum ko unn kay tor tareeqon per ley aaye , aur tum per ( rehmat kay sath ) tawajjah farmaye , aur Allah her baat ka janney wala bhi hai , hikmat wala bhi hai .
Allah to chahta hai kay tumhari taraf tawajjah keray , aur jo log nafsani khuwaishaat kay peechay lagay huye hain woh chahtay hain kay tum raah-e-raast say hatt ker boht door jaa parro .
Allah chahta hai kay tumharay sath aasani ka moamla keray , aur insan kamzor peda huwa hai .

aey emaan walo ! aapas mein aik doosray kay maal nahaq tareeqay say naa khao , illa yeh kay koi tijarat bahami raza mandi say wajood mein aai ho ( to woh jaeez hai ) aur apney aap ko qatal naa kero .   yaqeen jano Allah tum per boht meharban hai .
aur jo shaks ziyadti aur zulm kay tor per aisa keray ga , to hum uss ko aag mein dakhil keren gay . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye bilkul aasaan hai .
agar tum unn baray baray gunahon say perhez kero jinn say tumhen roka gaya hai to tumhari choti buraiyon ka hum khud kaffara kerden gay ,   aur tum ko aik ba-izzat jagah dakhil keren gay .

aur jinn cheezon mein Allah ney tum ko aik doosray per foqiyat di hai , unn ki tamanna naa kero , mard jo kuch kamai keren gay unn ko uss mein say hissa milay ga , aur aurten jo kuch kamai keren gi unn ko uss mein say hissa milay ga .   aur Allah say uss ka fazal maanga kero . beyshak Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

aur hum ney her uss maal kay kuch waris muqarrar kiye hain jo walaiden aur qareeb tareen rishta daar chorr ker-jayen . aur jinn logon  say tum ney koi ehad baandha ho unn ko unn ka hissa do .   beyshak Allah her cheez ka gawah hai .

mard aurton kay nigran hain , kiyonkay Allah ney unn mein say aik ko doosray per fazilat di hai , aur kiyonkay mardon ney apney maal kharch kiye hain . chunacheh naik aurten farmanbardaar hoti hain , mard ki ghair mojoodgi mein Allah ki di hoi hifazat say ( uss kay huqooq ki ) hifazat kerti hain . aur jinn aurton say tumhen sarkashi ka andesha ho to ( pehlay ) unhen samjhao , aur ( agar iss say kaam naa chalay to ) unhen khuwab gaahon mein tanha chorr do , ( aur iss say bhi islaah naa ho to ) unhen maar saktay ho . phir agar woh tumhari baat maan len to unn kay khilaf kaarawai ka koi raasta talash naa kero . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabb kay oopper , sabb say bara hai .

aur agar tumhen miyan biwi kay darmiyan phoot parrney ka andesha ho to ( unn kay darmiyan faisla keraney kay liye ) aik munsif mard kay khandan mein say aur aik munsif aurat kay khandan mein say bhej do . agar woh dono islaah kerana chahen gay to Allah dono kay darmiyan ittifaq peda farma dey ga . beyshak Allah ko her baat ka ilm aur her baat ki khabar hai .

aur Allah ki ibadat kero , aur uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrao , aur walaiden kay sath acha sulook kero , neez rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno , qareeb walay paroshi , door walay paroshi ,   sath bethay ( ya sath kharray ) huye shaks   aur raah geer kay sath aur apney ghulam baandiyon kay sath bhi ( acha bartao rakho ) beyshak Allah kissi itraney walay shekhi baaz ko pasand nahi kerta .

aesay log jo khud bhi kanjoosi kertay hain aur doosron ko bhi kanjoosi ki talqeen kertay hain , aur Allah ney unn ko apney fazal say jo kuch dey rakha hai ussay chupatay hain . aur hum ney aesay nashukron kay liye zaleel ker-denay wala azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

aur woh log jo apney maal logon  ko dikhaney kay liye kharch kertay hain , aur naa Allah per emaan rakhtay hain , naa roz-e-aakhirat per . aur shetan jiss ka sathi ban jaye to woh bad-tareen sathi hota hai .

bhala unn ka kiya bigar jata agar yeh Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan ley aatay , aur Allah ney unn ko jo rizq ata farmaya hai uss mein say kuch ( naik kamon mein ) kharch ker-detay-? aur Allah ko unn ka haal khoob maloom hai .
Allah zarra barabar bhi kissi per zulm nahi kerta , aur agar koi naiki ho to ussay kaee guna ker deta hai , aur khud apney paas say azeem sawab deta hai .

phir ( yeh log soch rakhen kay ) uss waqt ( unn ka ) kiya haal hoga jab hum her ummat mein say aik gawah ley ker ayen gay aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tum ko inn logon  kay khilaf gawah kay tor per paish keren gay-?

jinn logon  ney kufr apna rakha hai aur Rasool kay sath nafarmani ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya hai , uss din woh yeh tamanna keren gay kay kaash unhen zameen ( mein dhansa ker uss ) kay barabar kerdiya jaye , aur woh Allah say koi baat chupa nahi saken gay .

aey emaan walo ! jab tum nashay ki halat mein ho to uss waqt tak namaz kay qareeb bhi naa jana jab tak tum jo kuch keh rahey ho ussay samajhney naa lago ,   aur janabat ki halat mein bhi jab tak ghusul naa kerlo , ( namaz jaeez nahi ) illa yeh kay tum musafir ho ( aur paani naa milay to tayammum ker kay namaz parh saktay ho ) . aur agar tum beemar ho ya safar per ho ya tum mein say koi qazaye hajat ki jagah say aaya ho ya tum ney aurton ko chooa ho , phir tum ko paani naa milay to pak mitti say tayammum kerlo , aur apney chehron aur haathon ka ( uss mitti say ) masah kerlo . beyshak Allah bara moaaf kernay wala bara bakhshney wala hai .

jinn logon  ko kitab ( yani toraat kay ilm ) mein say aik hissa diya gaya tha , kiya tum ney unn ko nahi dekha kay woh ( kiss tarah ) gumrahi mol ley rahey hain , aur chahtay hain kay tum bhi raastay say bhatak jao .
aur Allah tumharay dushmanon ko khoob janta hai , aur rakhwala banney kay liye bhi Allah kafi hai , aur madadgaar banney kay liye bhi Allah kafi hai .

yahudiyon mein say kuch woh hain jo ( toraat ) kay alfaz ko unn kay moaqa mehal say hata daaltay hain , aur apni zabanon ko torr maror ker aur deen mein taana zani kertay huye kehtay hain :  samey-na wa-asaena  aur  Asmey ghair musmey  aur  raeena  halankay agar woh yeh kehtay kay  samey-na wa-ataana  aur  Asmey wa-anzurna  to unn kay liye behtar aur raast bazi ka raasta hota ,   lekin unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal rakhi hai , iss liye thoray say logon  kay siwa woh emaan nahi latay .

aey ehal-e-kitab ! jo ( Quran ) hum ney abb nazil kiya hai , jo tumharay paas pehlay say mojood kitab ki tasdeeq bhi kerta hai , uss per emaan ley aao , qabal iss kay kay hum kuch chehron ko mita ker unhen guddi jaisa bana den , ya unn per aesi phitkaar daal den jaisi phitkaar hum ney sabt walon per daali thi .   aur Allah ka hukum hamesha poora ho ker rehta hai .

beyshak Allah iss baat ko moaaf nahi kerta kay uss kay sath kissi ko shareek thehraya jaye , aur iss say kamtar her baat ko jiss kay liye chahta hai moaaf ker deta hai ,   aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehrata hai woh aisa bohtan baandhta hai jo bara zabardast gunah hai .

kiya tum ney inn logon  ko nahi dekha jo apney aap ko bara pakeezah batatay hain-? halankay pakeezgi to Allah jiss ko chahta hai ata kerta hai , aur ( iss ata mein ) unn per aik taagay kay barabar bhi zulm nahi hota .
dekho yeh log Allah per kaisay kaisay jhootay bohtan baandhtay hain , aur khula gunah honey kay liye yehi baat kafi hai .

jinn logon  ko kitab ( yani toraat kay ilm ) mein say aik hissa diya gaya tha kiya tum ney unn-ko nahi dekha kay woh ( kiss tarah ) button aur shetan ki tasdeeq ker rahey hain aur kafiron ( yani butt paraston ) kay baaray mein kehtay hain kay yeh mominon say ziyada seedhay raastay per hain .
yeh woh log hain jinn per Allah ney phitkaar daal rakhi hai , aur jiss per Allah phitkaar daal dey , uss kay liye tum koi madadgaar nahi pao gay .
to kiya inn ko ( kainat ki ) badshahi ka kuch hissa mila huwa hai ? agar aisa hota to yeh logon  ko guthli kay shigaaf kay barabar bhi kuch naa detay .

ya yeh logon  say iss bana per hasad kertay hain kay Allah ney inn ko apna fazal ( kiyon ) ata farmaya hai-? so hum ney to Ibrahim kay khandan ko kitab aur hikmat ata ki thi aur unhen bari saltanat di thi .
chunacheh unn mein say kuch unn per emaan laye aur kuch ney unn say mun morr liya . aur jahannum aik bharakti aag ki shakal mein ( unn kafiron ki khabar lenay kay liye ) kafi hai .

beyshak jinn logon  ney humari aayaton say inkar kiya hai hum unhen aag mein dakhil keren gay . jab bhi unn ki khalen jal jal ker pakk jayen gi , to hum unhen unn kay badlay doosri khalen dey den gay takay woh azab ka maza chaken . beyshak Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .

aur jo log emaan laye hain aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko hum aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , jinn mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . wahan unn kay liye pakeezah biwiyan hon gi , aur hum unhen ghani chaon mein dakhil keren gay .

. ( musalmano ! ) yaqeenan Allah tumhen hukum deta hai kay tum amanaten unn kay haq daaron tak phonchao , aur jab logon  kay darmiyan faisla kero to insaf kay sath faisla kero . yaqeen jano Allah tum ko jiss baat ki naseehat kerta hai woh boht achi hoti hai . beyshak Allah her baat ko sunta aur her cheez ko dekhta hai .

aey emaan walo ! Allah ki itaat kero aur uss kay Rasool ki bhi itaat kero aur tum mein say jo log sahab-e-ikhtiyar hon , unn ki bhi .   phir agar tumharay darmiyan kissi cheez mein ikhtilaf hojaye to agar waqaee tum Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay ho to ussay Allah aur Rasool kay hawalay kerdo . yehi tareeqa behtareen hai aur iss ka anjam bhi sabb say behtar hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jo dawa yeh kertay hain kay woh uss kalam per bhi emaan ley aaye hain jo tum per nazil kiya gaya hai aur uss per bhi jo tum say pehlay nazil kiya gaya tha , ( lekin ) unn ki halat yeh hai kay woh apna muqadma faislay kay liye taghoot kay paas ley jana chahtay hain-?   halankay unn ko hukum yeh diya gaya tha kay woh uss ka khul ker inkar keren . aur shetan chahta hai kay unhen bhatka ker perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala kerday .
aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay aao uss hukum ki taraf jo Allah ney utaara hai aur aao Rasool ki taraf , to tum unn munafiqon ko dekho gay kay woh tum say poori tarah mun morr bethay hain .

phir uss waqt unn ka kiya haal banta hai jab khud apney haathon kay kartoot ki wajeh say unn per koi museebat aa-parti hai-? uss waqt yeh aap kay paas Allah ki qasmen khatay huye aatay hain kay humara maqsad bhalai kernay aur milaap kera-denay kay siwa kuch naa tha .

yeh woh hain kay Allah inn kay dilon ki sari baaten khoob janta hai . lehaza tum enhen nazar andaz kerdo , enhen naseehat kero , aur inn say khud inn kay baaray mein aesi baat kehtay raho jo dil mein utar janey wali ho .

aur hum ney koi Rasool iss kay siwa kissi aur maqsad kay liye nahi bheja kay Allah kay hukum say uss ki itaat ki jaye . aur jab unn logon  ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha , agar yeh uss waqt tumharay paas aa-ker Allah say maghfirat maangtay aur Rasool bhi unn kay liye maghfirat ki dua kertay to yeh Allah ko boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban paatay .

nahi , ( aey payghumber ! ) tumharay perwerdigar ki qasam ! yeh log uss waqt tak momin nahi hosaktay jab tak yeh apney bahami jhagrron mein tumhen faisal naa banayen , phir tum jo kuch faisla kero uss kay baaray mein apney dilon mein koi tangi mehsoos naa keren , aur uss kay aagay mukammal tor per sar-e-tasleem kham kerden .

aur agar hum unn kay liye yeh farz qarar dey detay kay tum apney aap ko qatal kero ya apney gharon say nikal jao to unn mein say thoray say logon  kay siwa koi uss per amal naa kerta . aur jiss baat ki unhen naseehat ki jarahi hai agar yeh log uss per amal kerletay to inn kay haq mein kahen behtar hota , aur unn mein khoob sabit qadmi peda ker deta
aur uss soorat mein hum unhen khud apney paas say yaqeenan ajar-e-azeem ata kertay .
aur unhen zaroor bil-zaroor seedhay raastay tak phoncha detay .
aur jo log Allah aur Rasool ki itaat keren gay to woh unn kay sath hon gay jinn per Allah ney inaam farmaya hai , yani anbiya , siddiqeen , shohda aur sualeheen aur woh kitney achay sathi hain !
yeh fazilat Allah ki taraf say milti hai , aur ( logon  kay halaat say ) poori tarah ba-khabar honey kay liye Allah kafi hai .
aey emaan walo ! ( dushman say muqablay kay waqt ) apney bachao ka saman sath rakho , phir alag alag daston ki shakal mein ( jihad kay liye ) niklo , ya sabb log ikatthay ho ker nikal jao

aur yaqeenan tum mein koi aisa bhi zaroor hoga jo ( jihad mein janey say ) susti dikhaye ga , phir agar ( jihad kay doran ) tum per koi museebat aajaye to woh kahey ga kay Allah ney mujh per bara inaam kiya kay mein inn logon  kay sath mojood nahi tha .

aur agar Allah ki taraf say koi fazal ( yani fatah aur maal-e-ghaneemat ) tumharay haath aaye to woh kahey ga goya tumharay aur uss kay darmiyan kabhi koi dosti to thi hi nahi   kay  kaash mein bhi inn logon  kay sath hota to boht kuch meray bhi haath lagg jata !

lehaza Allah kay raastay mein woh log larren jo dunyawi zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay bech den . aur jo Allah kay raastay mein laray ga , phir chahye qatal hojaye ya ghalib aajaye , ( her soorat mein ) hum uss ko zabardast sawab ata keren gay .

aur ( aey musalmano ! ) tumharay paas kiya jawaz hai kay Allah kay raastay mein aur unn bey bus mardon , aurton aur bacchon ki khatir naa larro jo yeh dua ker rahey hain kay  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen iss basti say nikal laiye jiss kay bashinday zulm torr rahey hain , aur humaray liye apni taraf say koi haami peda ker-dijiye , aur humaray liye apni taraf say koi madadgaar kharra ker-dijiye

jo log emaan laye huye hain woh Allah kay raastay mein larrtay hain , aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai woh taghoot kay raastay mein larrtay hain . lehaza ( aey musalmano ! ) tum shetan kay doston say larro . ( yaad rakho kay ) shetan ki chaalen dar-haqeeqat kamzor hain .

kiya tum ney unn logon  ko nahi dekha jinn say ( makki zindagi mein ) kaha jata tha kay apney haath rok ker rakho , aur namaz qaeem kiye jao aur zakat detay raho . phir jab unn per jang farz ki gaee to unn mein say aik jamat ( dushman ) logon  say aesi darney lagi jaisay Allah say dara jata hai , ya uss say bhi ziyada darney lagi , aur aesay log kehney lagay kay  aey humaray perwerdigar ! aap ney hum per jang kiyon farz kerdi , thori mauddat tak hamen mohlat kiyon nahi di-?  keh do kay duniya ka faeeda to thora saa hai , aur jo shaks taqwa ikhtiyar keray uss kay liye aakhirat kahen ziyada behtar hai ,   aur tum per aik tagay kay barabar bhi zulm nahi hoga .

tum jahan bhi hogay ( aik naa aik din ) moat tumhen ja-pakray gi , chahye tum mazboot qalon mein kiyon naa reh rahey ho . aur agar inn ( munafiqon ) ko koi bhalai phonchti hai to woh kehtay hain kay yeh Allah ki taraf say hai , aur agar inn ko koi bura waqiaa paish aajata hai to ( aey payghumber ! ) woh ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay yeh bura waqiaa aap ki wajeh say huwa hai . keh do kay her waqiaa Allah ki taraf say hota hai . inn logon  ko kiya hogaya hai kay yeh koi baat samajhney kay nazdeek tak nahi aatay-?

tumhen jo koi achai phonchti hai to woh mehaz Allah ki taraf say hoti hai aur jo koi burai phonchti hai , woh to tumharay apney sabab say hoti hai , aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen logon  kay paas Rasool bana ker bheja hai , aur Allah ( iss baat ki ) gawahi denay kay liye kafi hai .

jo Rasool ki itaat keray , uss ney Allah ki itaat ki , aur jo ( itaat say ) mun pher ley to ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen inn per nigran bana ker nahi bheja ( kay tumhen inn kay amal ka zimma daar thehraya jaye )

aur yeh ( munafiq log samney to ) itaat ka naam letay hain , magar yeh tumharay paas say bahir jatay hain to inn mein say aik giroh raat kay waqt tumhari baaton kay khilaf mashwaray kerta hai , aur yeh raat kay waqt jo mashwaray kertay hain , Allah woh sabb likh raha hai . lehaza tum inn ki perwa matt kero , aur Allah per bharosa rakho . aur Allah tumhari himayat kay liye bilkul kafi hai .
kiya yeh log Quran mein ghor o fiker say kaam nahi letay-? agar yeh Allah kay siwa kissi aur ki taraf say hota to woh uss mein ba-kasrat ikhtilafaat paatay .

aur jab inn ko koi bhi khabar phonchti hai , chahye woh aman ki ho ya khof peda kernay wali , to yeh log ussay ( tehqeeq kay baghair ) phelana shuroo ker-detay hain . aur agar yeh uss ( khabar ) ko Rasool kay paas ya ashaab-e-ikhtiyar kay paas ley jatay to unn mein say jo log uss ki khoj nikalney walay hain woh uss ki haqeeqat maloom kerletay .   aur ( musalmanon ! ) agar Allah ka fazal aur uss ki rehmat tum per naa hoti to thoray say logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb shetan kay peechay lagg jatay .

lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum Allah kay raastay mein jang kero , tum per apney siwa kissi aur ki zimma daari nahi hai . haan mominon ko targheeb detay raho . kuch baeed nahi kay Allah kafiron ki jang ka zor torr dey . aur Allah ka zor sabb say ziyada zabardast hai aur uss ki saza bari sakht .

jo shaks koi achi sifarish kerta hai , uss ko uss mein say hissa milta hai , aur jo koi buri sifarish kerta hai ussay uss burai mein say hissa milta hai . aur Allah her cheez per nazar rakhney wala hai .

aur jab tumhen koi shaks salam keray to tum ussay uss say bhi behtar tareeqay per salam kero , ya ( kam az kam ) unhi alfaz mein uss ka jawab dey do .   beyshak Allah her cheez ka hisab rakhney wala hai .

Allah woh hai kay uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi , woh tumhen zaroor bil-zaroor qayamat kay din ikattha keray ga jiss kay aaney mein koi shak nahi hai . aur kon hai jo Allah say ziyada baat ka sacha ho-?

phir tumhen kiya hogaya kay munafiqeen kay baaray mein tum do giroh ban gaye-? ,   halankay unhon ney jaisay kaam kiye hain unn ki bana per Allah ney unn ko ondha kerdiya hai . kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay aesay shaks ko hidayat per lao jissay Allah ( uss ki khuwaish kay mutabiq ) gumrahi mein mubtala ker-chuka aur jissay Allah gumrahi mein mubtala kerday , uss kay liye tum hergiz kabhi koi bhalai ka raasta nahi paaskatay .

yeh log chahtay yeh hain kay jiss tarah unhon ney kufr ko apna liya hai , issi tarah tum bhi kafir ban ker sabb barabar hojao . lehaza ( aey musalmano ! ) tum inn mein say kissi ko uss waqt tak dost naa banao jab tak woh Allah kay raastay mein hijrat naa kerlay . chunacheh agar woh ( hijrat say ) aeraaz keren to unn ko pakro , aur jahan bhi unhen pao , unhen qatal kerdo , aur unn mein say kissi ko naa apna dost banao , naa madadgaar .

haan woh log iss hukum say mustasna hain jo kissi aesi qoam say jaa milen jinn kay aur tumharay darmiyan koi ( sulah ka ) moahida hai , ya woh log jo tumharay paas iss tarah ayen kay unn kay dil tumharay khilaf jang kernay say bhi beyzar hon , aur apni qoam kay khilaf jang kernay say bhi   aur agar Allah chahta to unhen tum per musallat ker deta , to woh tum say zaroor jang kertay chunacheh agar woh tum say kinara-kashi kertay huye tum say jang naa keren , aur tum ko aman ki paishkash kerden to Allah ney tum ko unn kay khilaf kissi kaarawai ka koi haq nahi diya .

. ( munafiqeen mein ) kuch doosray log tumhen aesay milen gay jo yeh chahtay hain kay woh tum say bhi mehfooz rahen aur apni qoam say bhi . ( magar ) jab kabhi unn ko fitney ki taraf wapis bulaya jaye , woh uss mein ondhay mun ja-girtay hain .   chunacheh agar yeh log tum say ( jang kernay say ) alehdgi ikhtiyar naa keren , aur naa tumhen aman ki paishkash keren , aur naa apney haath roken , to inn ko bhi pakro , aur jahan kahen enhen pao , enhen qatal kero . aesay logon  kay khilaf Allah ney tum ko khula khula ikhtiyar dey diya hai .

kissi musalman ka yeh kaam nahi hai kay woh kissi doosray musalman ko qatal keray , illa yeh kay ghalati say aisa hojaye .   aur jo shaks kissi musalman ko ghalati say qatal ker bethay to uss per farz hai kay woh aik musalman ghulam azad keray aur diyat ( yani khoon baha ) maqtool kay warison ko phonchaye , illa yeh kay woh moaaf kerden . aur agar maqtool kissi aesi qoam say talluq rakhta ho jo tumhari dushman hai , magar woh khud musalman ho to , bus aik musalman ghulam ko azad kerna farz hai , ( khoon baha dena wajib nahi )   . aur agar maqtool unn logon  mein say ho jo ( musalman nahi , magar ) unn kay aur tumharay darmiyan koi moahida hai , to bhi yeh farz hai kay khoon baha uss kay warison tak phonchaya jaye , aur aik musalman ghulam ko azad kiya jaye .   haan agar kissi kay paas ghulam naa ho to uss per farz hai kay do maheenay tak musalsal rozay rakhay . yeh tauba ka tareeqa hai jo Allah ney muqarrar kiya hai , aur Allah aleem o hakeem hai .

aur jo shaks kissi musalman ko jaan bojh ker qatal keray to uss ki saza jahannum hai jiss mein woh hamesha rahey ga aur Allah uss per ghazab nazil keray ga aur lanat bhejay ga , aur Allah ney uss kay liye zabardast azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

aey emaan walo ! jab tum Allah kay raastay mein safar kero to tehqeeq say kaam liya kero , aur jo shaks tum ko salam keray to dunyawi zindagi ka saman hasil kernay ki khuwaish mein uss ko yeh naa kaho kay  tum momin nahi ho    kiyonkay Allah kay paas maal-e-ghaneemat kay baray zakheeray hain . tum bhi to pehlay aesay hi thay . phir Allah ney tum per fazal kiya .   lehaza tehqeeq say kaam lo . bey shak jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss sabb say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

jinn musalmanon ko koi maazoori laahaq naa ho aur woh ( jihad mein janey kay bajaye ghar mein ) beth rahen woh Allah kay raastay mein apney maal o jaan say jihad kernay walon kay barabar nahi hain . jo log apney maal o jaan say jihad kertay hain unn ko Allah ney beth rehney walon per darjay mein fazilat di hai . aur Allah ney sabb say achai ka wada ker rakha hai .   aur Allah ney mujahideen ko beth rehney walon per bari fazilat dey ker bara sawab bakhsha hai .
yani khaas apney paas say baray darjay aur maghfirat aur rehmat ! aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

jinn logon  ney apni janon per zulm kiya tha .   aur ussi halat mein farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kernay aaye to bolay  tum kiss halat mein thay ?  woh kehney lagay kay  hum to zameen mein bey bus bana diye gaye thay .  farishton ney kaha  kiya Allah ki zameen kushada naa thi kay tum uss mein hijrat ker-jatay-?  lehaza aesay logon  ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh nihayat bura anjam hai .
albatta woh bey bus mard , aurten aur bacchay ( iss anjam say mustasna hain ) jo ( hijrat ki ) koi tadbeer nahi ker-saktay aur naa ( nikalney ka ) koi raasta paatay hain .
chunacheh poori umeed hai kay Allah unn ko moaaf farmadey . Allah bara moaaf kernay wala boht bakhshney wala hai .

aur jo shaks Allah kay raastay mein hijrat keray ga woh zameen mein boht jagah aur bari gunjaeesh paye ga . aur jo shaks apney ghar say Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki taraf hijrat kernay kay liye niklay , phir ussay moat aa-pakray , tab bhi uss ka sawab Allah kay paas tey hochuka , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

aur jab tum zameen mein safar kero aur tumhen iss baat ka khof ho kay kafir log tumhen pareshan keren gay , to tum per iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum namaz mein qasar kerlo .   yaqeenan kafir log tumharay khulay dushman hain .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab tum unn kay darmiyan mojood ho aur unhen namaz parhao to ( dushman say muqablay kay waqt uss ka tareeqa yeh hai kay ) musalmanon ka aik giroh tumharay sath kharra hojaye , aur apney hathiyaar sath ley ley . phir jab yeh log sajda ker-chuken to tumharay peechay hojayen , aur doosra giroh jiss ney abhi tak namaz naa parhi ho aagay aajaye , aur woh tumharay sath namaz parhay , aur woh apney sath apney bachao ka saman aur apney hathiyaar ley ley . kafir log yeh chahtay hain kay tum apney hathiyaron aur apney saman say ghafil hojao to woh aik dum tum per toot parren . aur agar tumhen barish ki wajeh say takleef ho ya tum beemar ho to uss mein bhi tum per koi gunah nahi hai kay tum apney hathiyaar utaar ker rakh do , haan apney bachao ka saman sath ley lo . beyshak Allah ney kafiron kay liye zillat wala azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

phir jab tum namaz poori ker-chuko to Allah ko ( her halat mein ) yaad kertay raho , kharray bhi bethay bhi , aur letay huye bhi .   phir jab tumhen ( dushman ki taraf say ) itminan hasil hojaye to namaz qaeeday kay mutabiq parho . beyshak namaz musalmanon kay zimmay aik aisa fareeza hai jo waqt ka paband hai .

aur tum unn logon  ( yani kafir dushman ) ka peecha kernay mein kamzori naa dikhao , agar tumhen takleef phonchi hai to unn ko bhi ussi tarah takleef phonchi hai jaisay tumhen phonchi hai ,   aur tum Allah say uss baat kay umeedwaar ho jiss kay woh umeedwaar nahi . aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

beyshak hum ney haq per mushtamil kitab tum per iss liye utaari hai takay tum logon  kay darmiyan uss tareeqay kay mutabiq faisla kero jo Allah ney tum ko samjha diya hai , aur tum khayanat kernay walon kay taraf daar naa bano .
aur Allah say maghfirat talab kero , beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aur kissi tanazay mein unn logon  ki wakalat naa kerna jo khud apni janon say khayanat kertay hain . Allah kissi bhi khayanat kernay walay gunehgaar ko pasand nahi kerta .

yeh logon  say to sharmatay hain , aur Allah say nahi sharmatay , halankay woh uss waqt bhi unn kay paas hota hai jab woh raaton ko aesi baaten kertay hain jo Allah ko pasand nahi . aur jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain Allah ney uss sabb ka ehata ker rakha hai .

aray tumhari bisaat yehi to hai kay tum ney dunyawi zindagi mein logon  say jhagarr ker inn ( khayanat kernay walon ) ki himayat kerli ! bhala iss kay baad qayamat kay din Allah say jhagarr ker kon unn ki himayat keray ga , ya kon unn ka wakeel banay ga-?
aur jo shaks koi bura kaam ker guzray ya apni jaan per zulm ker bethay , phir Allah say moaafi maang ley to woh Allah ko boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban paye ga .
aur jo shaks koi gunah kamaye , to woh uss kamai say khud apney aap ko nuqsan phonchata hai . aur Allah poora ilm bhi rakhta hai , hikmat ka bhi malik hai .
aur agar koi shaks kissi ghalati ya gunah ka murtakib ho , phir uss ka ilzam kissi bey gunah kay zimmay laga dey , to woh bara bhari bohtan aur khula gunah apney oopper laad leta hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar Allah ka fazal aur rehmat tumharay shamil-e-haal naa hoti to unn mein say aik giroh ney to tum ko seedhi raah say bhatkaney ka irada ker hi liya tha .   aur ( dar-haqeeqat ) yeh apney siwa kissi ko nahi bhatka rahey hain , aur yeh tum ko zara bhi nuqsan nahi phonchayen gay . Allah ney tum per kitab aur hikmat nazil ki hai aur tum ko unn baaton ka ilm diya hai jo tum nahi jantay thay , aur tum per Allah ka fazal hamesha boht ziyada raha hai .

logon  ki boht si khufiya sargoshiyon mein koi khair nahi hoti , illa yeh kay koi shaks sadqay ka ya kissi naiki ka ya logon  kay darmiyan islaah ka hukum dey . aur jo shaks Allah ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye aisa keray ga , hum uss ko zabardast sawab ata keren gay .

aur jo shaks apney samney hidayat wazeh honey kay baad bhi Rasool ki mukhalifat keray , aur mominon kay raastay kay siwa kissi aur raastay ki perwi keray , uss ko hum ussi raah kay hawalay kerden gay jo uss ney khud apnai hai , aur ussay dozakh mein jhonken gay , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

beyshak Allah iss baat ko nahi bakhshta kay uss kay sath kissi ko shareek thehraya jaye , aur iss say kamtar her gunah ki jiss kay liye chahta hai bakhshish ker deta hai .   aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehrata hai , woh raah-e-raast say bhatak ker boht door jaa girta hai .
Allah ko chorr ker jinn say yeh duayen maang rahey hain woh sirf chand zananiyan hain ,   aur jiss ko yeh pukar rahey hain woh iss/uss sarkash shetan kay siwa koi nahi .
jiss per Allah ney phitkaar daal rakhi hai , aur uss ney ( Allah say ) yeh keh rakha hai kay  mein teray bandon say aik tey shuda hissa ley ker rahun ga ,

aur mein unhen raah-e-raast say bhatka ker rahun ga , aur unhen khoob aarzooyen dilaon ga , aur unhen hukum dun ga to woh chopayo kay kaan cheer daalen gay , aur unhen hukum dun ga to woh Allah ki takhleeq mein tabdeeli peda keren gay .    aur jo shaks Allah kay bajaye shetan ko dost banaye iss ney khulay khulay khasaray ka soda kiya .
woh to unn say waday kerta aur unhen aarzoon mein mubtala kerta hai , jabkay ( haqeeqat yeh hai kay ) shetan unn say jo bhi waday kerta hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi .
unn sabb ka thikana jahannum hai , aur unn ko uss say bachnay kay liye koi raah-e-farar nahi milay gi .

aur jo log emaan laye hein aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain hum unn ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keren gay jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , yeh unn mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay . yeh Allah ka sacha wada hai , aur Allah say ziyada baat ka sacha kon hosakta hai-?

naa tumhari tamannayen ( jannat mein janey kay liye ) kafi hain , naa ehal-e-kitab ki aarzooyen . jo bhi bura amal keray ga , uss ki saza paye ga , aur Allah kay siwa ussay apna koi yaaro madadgaar nahi milay ga .

aur jo shaks naik kaam keray ga , chahye woh mard ho ya aurat , ba-shartey-kay momin ho , to aesay log jannat mein dakhil hon gay , aur khujoor ki guthli kay shigaaf barabar bhi unn per zulm nahi hoga .

aur uss say behtar kiss ka deen hoga jiss ney apney chehray ( samet saray wajood ) ko Allah kay aagay jhuka diya ho , jabkay woh naiki ka khoogar bhi ho , aur jiss ney seedhay sachay Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi ki ho . aur ( yeh maloom hi hai kay ) Allah ney Ibrahim ko apna khaas dost bana liya tha .
aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai , aur Allah ney her cheez ko ( apni qudrat kay ) ehatay mein liya huwa hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) log tum say aurton kay baaray mein shariyat ka hukum poochtay hain .   keh do kay Allah tum ko unn kay baaray mein hukum batata hai , aur iss kitab ( yani Quran ) ki jo aayaten jo tum ko parh ker sunai jati hain woh bhi unn yateem aurton kay baaray mein ( sharaee hukum batati hain ) jinn ko tum unn ka muqarrar shuda haq nahi detay , aur unn say nikah kerna bhi chahtay ho ,   neez kamzor bacchon kay baaray mein bhi ( hukum batati hain ) aur yeh takeed kerti hain kay tum yateemon ki khatir insaf qaeem kero . aur tum jo bhalai ka kaam kero gay , Allah ko uss ka poora poora ilm hai .

aur agar kissi aurat ko apney shohar ki taraf say ziyadti ya beyzari ka andesha ho to unn miyan biwi kay liye iss mein koi muzaeeqa nahi hai kay woh aapas kay ittifaq say kissi qisam ki sulah kerlen .   aur sulah kerlna behtar hai aur insanon kay dil mein ( kuch naa kuch ) lalach ka mada to rakh hi diya gaya hai .   aur agar ehsan aur taqwa say kaam lo to jo kuch tum kero gay Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

aur aurton kay darmiyan mukammal barabari rakhna to tumharay bus mein nahi , chahye tum aisa chahtay bhi ho ,   albatta kissi aik taraf pooray pooray naa jhuk jao kay doosri ko aisa bana ker chorr do jaisay koi bech mein latki hoi cheez . aur agar tum islaah aur taqwa say kaam lo gay to yaqeen rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aur agar dono juda ho hi jayen to Allah apni ( qudrat aur rehmat ki ) wusat say dono ko ( aik doosray ki hajat say ) bey niaz kerday ga .   Allah bari wasaton wala , bari hikmat wala hai .

aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai . hum ney tum say pehlay ehal-e-kitab ko bhi aur tumhen bhi yehi takeed ki hai kay Allah say daro aur agar tum kufr apnao gay to ( Allah ka kiya nuqsan hai ? kiyonkay ) aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai , aur Allah her aik say bey niaz aur bazaat-e-khud laeeq-e-tareef hai .
aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai ,   aur kaam bananey kay liye Allah hi kafi hai .
agar woh chahye to aey logo ! tum sabb ko ( duniya say ) ley jaye aur doosron ko ( tumhari jagah yahan ) ley aaye . Allah iss baat ki poori qudrat rakhta hai .

jo shaks ( sirf ) duniya ka sawab chahta ho ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah kay paas duniya aur aakhirat dono ka sawab mojood hai .   Allah aisa hai kay her baat ko sunta aur her cheez ko janta hai .

aey emaan walo ! insaf qaeem kernay walay bano , Allah ki khatir gawahi denay walay , chahye woh gawahi tumharay apney khilaf parrti ho , ya walaiden aur qareebi rishta daaron kay khilaf . woh shaks ( jiss kay khilaf gawahi denay ka hukum diya jaa raha hai ) chahye ameer ho ya gharib , Allah dono qisam kay logon  ka ( tum say ) ziyada khair khuwa hai , lehaza aesi nafsani khuwaish kay peechay naa chalna jo tumhen insaf kernay say rokti ho . aur agar tum torr maror kero gay ( yani ghalat gawahi do gay ) ya ( sachi gawahi denay say ) pehlo bachao gay to ( yaad rakhna kay ) Allah tumharay tamaam kamon say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

aey emaan walo ! Allah per emaan rakho , aur uss kay Rasool per aur uss kitab per jo Allah ney apney Rasool per utaari hai aur her uss kitab per jo uss ney pehlay utaari thi . aur jo shaks Allah ka , uss kay farishton ka , uss ki kitabon ka , uss kay Rasoolon ka aur yoam-e-aakhirat ka inkar keray woh bhatak ker gumrahi mein boht door jaa parra hai .
jo log emaan laye , phir kafir hogaye , phir emaan laye , phir kafir hogaye , phir kufr mein barhtay hi chalay gaye , Allah unn ko bakhshney wala nahi hai , aur naa unhen raastay per laney wala hai .
munafiqon ko yeh khushkhabri suna do kay unn kay liye aik dukh denay wala azab tayyar hai .
woh munafiq jo musalmanon kay bajaye kafiron ko dost banatay hain , kiya woh unn kay paas izzat talash ker rahey hain-? halankay izzat to sari ki sari Allah hi ki hai .

aur uss ney kitab mein tum per yeh hukum nazil kiya hai kay jab tum Allah ki aayaton ko suno kay unn ka inkar kiya jaraha hai aur unn ka mazaq uraya jaraha hai to aesay logon  kay sath uss waqt tak matt betho jab tak woh kissi aur baat mein mashghool naa hojayen , werna tum bhi unhi jaisay hojao gay . yaqeen rakho kay Allah tamam munafiqon aur kafiron ko jahannum mein ikattha kernay wala hai .

. ( aey musalmano ! ) yeh woh log hain jo tumharay ( anjam kay ) intizar mein bethay rehtay hain . chunacheh agar tumhen Allah ki taraf say fatah milay to ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay  kiya hum tumharay sath naa thay ?  aur agar kafiron ko ( fatah ) naseeb ho to ( unn say ) kehtay hain kay  kiya hum ney tum per qaboo nahi paaliya tha-? aur kiya ( iss kay bawajood ) hum ney tumhen musalmanon say nahi bachaya    bus abb to Allah hi qayamat kay din tumharay aur unn kay darmiyan faisla keray ga , aur Allah kafiron kay liye musalmanon per ghalib aaney ka hergiz koi raasta nahi rakhay ga .

yeh munafiq Allah kay sath dhoka bazi kertay hain , halankay Allah ney unhen dhokay mein daal rakha hai .   aur jab yeh log namaz kay liye kharray hotay hain to kusmusatay huye kharray hotay hain , logon  kay samney dikhawa kertay hain , aur Allah ko thora hi yaad kertay hain

yeh kufr o emaan kay darmiyan daanwa-dol hain . naa pooray tor per inn ( musalmanon ) ki taraf hain , naa unn ( kafiron ) ki taraf . aur jissay Allah gumrahi mein daal dey , tumhen uss kay liye hidayat per aaney ka koi raasta hergiz nahi mil sakta .

aey emaan walo ! musalmanon ko chorr ker kafiron ko dost matt banao . kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay Allah kay paas apney khilaf ( yani apney mustahiq-e-azab honey ki ) aik khuli khuli wajeh peda kerdo-?
yaqeen jano kay munafiq jahannum kay sabb say nichlay tabqay mein hon gay , aur unn kay liye tum koi madadgaar nahi pao gay .

albatta jo log tauba kerlen gay , apni islaah kerlen gay , Allah ka sahara mazboot say thaam len gay aur apney deen ko khalis Allah kay liye bana len gay to aesay log mominon kay sath shamil hojayen gay , aur Allah mominon ko zaroor ajar-e-azeem ata keray ga .

agar tum shukar guzaar bano aur ( sahih maani mein ) emaan ley aao to Allah tumhen azab dey ker aakhir kiya keray ga-? Allah bara qadardaan hai , ( aur ) sabb kay halaat ka poori tarah ilm rakhta hai .
Allah uss baat ko pasand nahi kerta kay kissi ki burai aelania zaban per laee jaye , illa yeh kay kissi per zulm huwa ho .   aur Allah sabb kuch sunta , her baat janta hai .

agar tum koi naik kaam aelania kero ya khufiya tor per kero , ya kissi burai ko moaaf kerdo , to ( behtar hai , kiyonkay ) Allah boht moaaf kernay wala hai ( agar-cheh saza denay per ) poori qudrat rakhta hai .

jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon ka inkar kertay hain aur Allah aur uss kay Rasoolon kay darmiyan farq kerna chahtay aur kehtay hain kay kuch ( Rasoolon ) per to hum emaan latay hain aur kuch ka inkar kertay hain , aur ( iss tarah ) woh chahtay hain kay ( kufr aur emaan kay darmiyan ) aik bech ki raah nikal len .
aesay log sahih maani mein kafir hain , aur kafiron kay liye hum ney zillat aamez azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

aur jo log Allah per aur uss kay Rasoolon per emaan layen , aur unn mein say kissi kay darmiyan farq naa keren , to Allah aesay logon  ko unn kay ajar ata keray ga , aur Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) ehal-e-kitab tum say ( jo ) mutalba ker rahey hain kay tum unn per aasman say koi kitab nazil kerwao , to ( yeh koi naee baat nahi , kiyonkay ) yeh log to musa say iss say bhi bara mutalba ker-chukay hain . chunacheh unhon ney ( musa say ) kaha tha kay hamen Allah khuli aankhon dikhao , chunacheh unn ki sarkashi ki wajeh say unn ko bijli kay karrkay ney aa-pakra tha , phir unn kay paas jo khuli khuli nishaniyan ayen , unn kay baad bhi unhon ney bachrray ko mabood bana liya tha . iss per bhi hum ney unhen moaaf kerdiya , aur hum ney musa ko wazeh iqtidar ata kiya .

aur hum ney koh-e-toor ko unn per buland ker kay unn say ehad liya tha , aur hum ney unn say kaha tha kay ( shehar kay ) darwazay mein jhukay huye saron kay sath dakhil hona , aur unn say kaha tha kay tum saneechar kay din kay baaray mein hadd say naa guzarna   aur hum ney unn say boht paka ehad liya tha .

phir unn kay sath jo kuch huwa , woh iss liye kay unhon ney apna ehad torra , Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya , anbiya ko nahaq qatal kiya , aur yeh kaha kay humaray dilon per ghilaf charha huwa hai   halankay haqeeqat yeh hai kay unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn kay dilon per mohar laga di hai , iss liye woh thori si baaton kay siwa kissi baat per emaan nahi latay
aur iss liye kay unhon ney kufr ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya , aur maryam per baray bhari bohtan ki baat kahi .

aur yeh kaha kay :  hum ney Allah kay Rasool maseeh essa ibn-e-maryam ko qatal kerdiya tha  halankay naa unhon ney essa ( aleh-assalam ) ko qatal kiya tha , naa unhen sooli dey paye thay , balkay unhen ishtaba hogaya tha .   aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay jinn logon  ney iss baaray mein ikhtilaf kiya hai , woh iss silsilay mein shak ka shikar hain ,   unhen gumaan kay peechay chalney kay siwa iss baat ka koi ilm hasil nahi hai , aur yeh bilkul yaqeeni baat hai kay woh essa ( aleh-assalam ) ko qatal nahi ker paye .
balkay Allah ney unhen apney paas utha liya tha , aur Allah bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara hikmat wala hai
aur ehal-e-kitab mein say koi aisa nahi hai jo apni moat say pehlay zaroor bil zaroor essa ( aleh-assalam ) per emaan naa laye ,   aur qayamat kay din woh unn logon  kay khilaf gawah banen gay .

gharz yahudiyon ki sangeen ziyadti ki wajeh say hum ney unn per woh pakeezah cheezen haram kerden jo pehlay unn kay liye halal ki gaee then .   aur iss liye kay woh ba-kasrat logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roktay thay .

aur sood liya kertay thay , halankay unhen uss say mana kiya gaya tha , aur logon  kay maal nahaq tareeqay say khatay thay . aur unn mein say jo log kafir hain , unn kay liye hum ney aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

albatta inn ( bani Israel ) mein say jo log ilm mein pakay hain , aur momin hain , woh iss ( kalam ) per bhi emaan rakhtay hain jo ( aey payghumber ! ) tum per nazil kiya gaya aur uss per bhi jo tum say pehlay nazil kiya gaya tha , aur qabil-e-tareef hain woh log jo namaz qaeem kernay walay hain , zakat denay walay hain aur Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhney walay hain . yeh woh log hain jinhen hum ajar-e-azeem ata keren gay .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumharay paas ussi tarah wahi bheji hai jaisay nooh aur unn kay baad doosray nabiyon kay paas bheji thi , aur hum ney Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad kay paas , aur essa , Ayub , Younus , Haroon aur suleman kay paas bhi wahi bheji thi , aur hum ney dawood ko zaboor ata ki thi .

aur boht say Rasool hain jinn kay waqiyaat hum ney pehlay tumhen sunaye hain , aur boht say Rasool aesay hain kay hum ney unn kay waqiyaat tumhen nahi sunaye . aur musa say to Allah barah-e-raast hum kalam huwa .

yeh sabb Rasool woh thay jo ( sawab ki ) khushkhabri sunaney aur ( dozakh say ) daraney walay bana ker bhejay gaye thay , takay inn Rasoolon kay aajaney kay baad logon  kay paas Allah kay samney koi uzr baqi naa rahey , aur Allah ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

. ( yeh kafir log maanen ya naa maanen ) lekin Allah ney jo kuch tum per nazil kiya hai , uss kay baaray mein woh khud gawahi deta hai kay uss ney ussay apney ilm say nazil kiya hai , aur farishtay bhi gawahi detay hain , aur ( yun to ) Allah ki gawahi hi bilkul kafi hai .
yaqeen jano kay jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai aur logon  ko Allah kay raastay say roka hai woh bhatak ker gumrahi mein boht door nikal gaye hain .
jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai ( aur doosron ko Allah kay raastay say rok ker unn per ) zulm kiya hai , Allah unn ko bakhshney wala nahi hai , aur naa unn ko koi aur raasta dikhaney wala hai .
siwaye dozakh kay raastay kay jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye boht mamooli baat hai .

aey logo ! yeh Rasool tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say haq ley ker aagaye hain . abb ( inn per ) emaan ley aao , kay tumhari behtari issi mein hai . aur agar ( abb bhi ) tum ney kufr ki raah apnai to ( khoob samajh lo kay ) tamam aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai Allah hi ka hai , aur Allah ilm aur hikmat dono ka malik hai .

aey ehal-e-kitab ! apney deen mein hadd say naa barho , aur Allah kay baaray mein haq kay siwa koi baat naa kaho . maseeh essa ibn-e-maryam to mehaz Allah kay Rasool thay , aur Allah ka aik kalma tha jo iss/uss ney maryam tak phonchaya , aur aik rooh thi jo ussi/issi ki taraf say ( peda hoi ) thi .   lehaza Allah aur iss/uss kay Rasoolon per emaan lao , aur yeh matt kaho kay ( khuda ) teen hain . iss/uss baat say baaz aajao , kay ussi/issi mein tumhari behtari hai . Allah to aik hi mabood hai woh iss/uss baat say bilkul pak hai kay iss/uss ka koi beta ho . aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ussi/issi ka hai , aur sabb ki dekh bhaal kay liye Allah kafi hai .

maseeh kabhi iss baat ko aar nahi samajh saktay kay woh Allah kay banday hon , aur naa muqarrab farishtay ( iss mein koi aar samajhtay hain ) . aur jo shaks apney perwerdigar ki bandagi mein aar samjhay , aur takabbur ka muzahira keray , to ( woh achi tarah samajh ley kay ) Allah unn sabb ko apney paas jama keray ga .

phir jo log emaan laye hon gay aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hon gay , unn ko unn ka poora poora sawab dey ga , aur apney fazal say iss say ziyada bhi dey ga . rahey woh log jinhon ney ( bandagi ko ) aar samjha hoga aur takabbur ka muzahira kiya hoga , to unn ko dardnak azab dey ga , aur unn ko Allah kay siwa apna koi rakhwala aur madadgaar nahi milay ga .
aey logo ! tumharay paas tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say khuli daleel aa-chuki hai , aur hum ney tumharay paas aik aesi roshni bhej di hai jo raastay ki poori wazahat kernay wali hai .

chunacheh jo log Allah per emaan laye hain aur unhon ney ussi ka sahara thaam liya hai , Allah unn ko apney fazal aur rehmat mein dakhil keray ga aur unhen apney paas aaney kay liye seedhay raastay tak phonchaye ga .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) log tum say ( kalala ka hukum ) poochtay hain . keh do kay Allah tumhen kalala   kay baaray mein hukum batata hai . agar koi shaks iss haal mein mar-jaye kay uss ki aulad naa ho , aur uss ki aik behan ho to woh uss kay tarkay mein say aadhay ki haq daar hogi . aur agar uss behan ki aulad naa ho ( aur woh mar-jaye , aur uss ka bhai zinda ho ) to woh uss behan ka waris hoga . aur agar behney do hon to bhai kay tarkay say woh do tehai ki haq daar hon gi . aur agar ( marney walay kay ) bhai bhi hon aur behney bhi , to aik mard ko do aurton kay barabar hissa milay ga . Allah tumharay samney wazahat kerta hai takay tum gumrah naa ho , aur Allah her cheez ka poora ilm rakhta hai .
